Home / Naval Museums / Midget Submarine Ha-21

Location 1: ANZAC Memorial, 126 Elizabeth St, Sydney NSW 2000, Australia

Location 2: HMAS Kuttabul Garden Island Precinct, Wylde St, Potts Point, NSW 2011, Australia

Location 3: Australian War Memorial, Treloar Cres, Campbell, ACT 2612, Australia

Visited: 7 Oct 2023 (Hyde Park); 23 Oct 2023, 26 June 2024 (Garden Island); 14 Nov 2015, 9 Nov 2019, 2 May 2026 (Australian War Memorial)

This is the stern section of Japanese midget submarine Ha-21, which took part in the attack on Sydney in June 1942.

It used to be stored in the RAN heritage storage facility on Spectacle Island (which has since been closed). In 2023 it was put on display in a temporary exhibition at the ANZAC Memorial, in Hyde Park, Sydney, which is where the photograph was taken. In 2024 the display in Hyde Park was removed, and the stern section relocated to the Australian National Maritime Museum in another temporary display.

As for the rest of the submarine, the conning tower is on display in the RAN Heritage Centre on Garden Island, Sydney. The RAN Heritage Centre closed to the public in 2024, however as of August 2026 the centre’s artefacts were still housed within the building on Garden Island.

The bow section of Ha-21 is held by the Australian War Memorial in Canberra, where it is combined with the conning tower and stern section of sister-submarine Ha-14 to form a composite display.
